tasks.short: Plan and develop mathematical or statistical environmental research models

steps.what: Plan the environmental research model, selecting mathematical/statistical concepts, variables, assumptions and validation criteria
inputs: actual research question and environmental mechanism
actual data definitions, sampling design and limitations
outputs: scientist's research-model specification and validation plan

steps.what: Develop the specified research model using native mathematical/statistical model components and actual research inputs
inputs: scientist's research-model specification and validation plan
actual research data with units and provenance

steps.what: Test model calculations, identifiability, sensitivity and fit against actual validation criteria and data
inputs: scientist's research-model specification and validation plan
outputs: actual research-model validation results and limits

steps.what: Complete and check the actual research model version, assumptions and validation annotations
inputs: actual research-model validation results and limits
outputs: complete checked research model and annotations

steps.what: Save the completed checked research model and annotations in the existing research workspace
inputs: complete checked research model and annotations

tasks.design: Configure native reusable mathematical/statistical components in {OTHER}, the scientific modelling application, for the scientist's specified model. The scientist chooses the concepts, checks implementation and validity, and completes the actual model annotations before saving in {DOCS}; native computation already belongs to today's work.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated implementation setup can consume effort even when the scientific model is specified.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reusable components can implement selected equations or statistical structures without generating scientific assumptions.
tasks.still_hard: Identifiability, causal interpretation and transfer beyond observed data require scientific judgment.
tasks.human_edge: Reject a well-fitting model that cannot answer the actual research question.

ambition.what: No automatic model selection or research finding.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native mathematical/statistical components can reduce repeated setup while research-model specification and validation remain scientist-led.

assumptions: Shares are provisional human model-development effort, not solver runtime or a measured baseline.
Research data owners supply actual observations with variable definitions, units and provenance; the scientist checks limitations and selects inputs in s1/s2. Missing definitions remain manual work.
Only repeatable component setup changes. Novel equations, data cleaning and all validation remain counted; existing equivalent components remove the gain.
Gross provisional saving 5 minus 1.5 hours of component validation/upkeep gives 3.5 net. The negligible save is fully retained.
The final model is checked through ordinary completion/validation work, not an added self-approval ceremony.
research_questions: Which real model implementations repeat setup beyond current scientific tools?

already_counted.description: Inspect implemented components and validate research behaviour

incremental.description: Maintain and validate reusable component configurations

approvals.approved_version: complete checked research model and annotations

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 3.5%; scientific model choice and validation remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop methods to reduce production-process environmental impacts

steps.what: Study actual industrial production, environmental legislation and physical, biological and social conditions affecting process impacts
inputs: actual production-process description and measured impacts
actual applicable authoritative sources and environmental/social evidence

steps.what: Develop methods to minimize production-process environmental impacts from the actual study and assessment
inputs: actual process operating limits and environmental objectives

steps.what: Evaluate candidate methods for technical feasibility, displaced impacts, implementation constraints and uncertainty
outputs: scientist's assessed reduction methods and limitations

steps.what: Complete and check the actual proposed method specification, supporting evidence and unresolved conditions
inputs: scientist's assessed reduction methods and limitations
outputs: complete checked environmental impact-reduction method specification

steps.what: Save the completed checked environmental impact-reduction method specification
inputs: complete checked environmental impact-reduction method specification

tasks.design: Configure native process/evidence source views in {OTHER}, the environmental assessment application, and {DOCS}. The scientist studies actual conditions, develops and assesses methods using existing {SPREADSHEET} calculations, then completes the method specification before saving; no process changes or regulatory conclusions are automated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated navigation among actual process and environmental sources can interrupt method development.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source views can expose existing evidence without interpreting applicability.
tasks.still_hard: Reducing one impact may move it to another medium or create an operational constraint.
tasks.human_edge: Develop a workable method that accounts for the actual process and affected environment.

ambition.what: No automatic process intervention or quantified impact reduction claimed.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-6 for process/environment records and responsible operator consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native environmental evidence views can reduce navigation while process-impact method development and feasibility assessment remain expert work.

assumptions: Shares are unmeasured human method-development effort, not an invented production baseline.

Operators supply actual process conditions, laboratory/environment teams supply actual observations and authoritative publishers supply source text. The scientist investigates gaps within s1 and assesses applicability in s2/s3.
No new structured process feed, environmental measurements or free social-impact assessment is assumed. Only navigation changes; equivalent current views remove the gain.
Gross provisional saving 3.5 minus 1 hour of source-view upkeep gives 2.5 net. Existing calculations and the negligible save earn no new saving.
The deliverable is the actual proposed method specification. Operational trial approval, process commits and any external submissions require their existing responsible processes.
unknowns: Actual source fragmentation and feasibility evidence
research_questions: Does actual method development repeat evidence navigation beyond existing assessment software?

already_counted.description: Read actual process and environmental evidence

incremental.description: Maintain source views and provenance links

approvals.approved_version: complete checked environmental impact-reduction method specification

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 2.5%; actual method development and feasibility assessment remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.ambitious_version: Reduce repeated setup and evidence navigation while retaining scientific model and environmental-method development.

job.title: Environmental Scientists and Specialists, Including Health
